title: The projective line is a genus-zero smooth proper connected curve
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $P=\mathbf P^1_k=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};\operatorname{Spec}k)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Then $P$ is a smooth proper connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves] and its genus [def-sc-genus] is zero: $H^1(P,\mathcal O_P)=0$.

source.place: Tag 0B2P, varieties.tex, lemma-projective-space-smooth (n=1: smooth projective variety of dimension one); Tag 0C6U, curves.tex, proposition-projective-line, implication (1) to (2) and (7); properness of projective space is the existing lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper

proof.text: Use the existing standard-chart proof ProjectiveLine.smoothOfRelativeDimension_one: each standard open of the base-change projective line is affine one-space, and AffineSpace.smoothOfRelativeDimension_over [sbc-lem-affine-space-smooth] and the source-local criterion [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] give smooth relative dimension one. The charts and their base compatibility are already constructed in ProjectiveSpace.Charts; no comparison with a different polynomial-Proj model is needed.

Use the existing ProjectiveLine.connectedSpace, whose proof connects the two affine-line charts by the point with both homogeneous coordinates one. This supplies nonemptiness. Apply topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension [lem-sbc-smooth-fixed-dimension-over-field] at dimension one. Properness [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper] supplies separatedness and finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism]. The equality of dimension gives its upper bound. Assemble IsConnectedCurve [def-sc-curves], and obtain Smooth from the smooth-relative-dimension instance.

Use parts (iii) and (i) of [lem-sc-p1-monomial]: the relative differential sheaf is isomorphic to O(-2), and H0(O(-2)) is zero because -2 is negative. Transport the subsingleton cohomology group along this isomorphism. Scheme.Hom.genus_eq_finrankH_zero expresses [def-sc-genus] as the dimension of this H0; the dimension of a subsingleton vector space is zero. This computes the differential-form genus directly without Serre duality.

Specialize [lem-sc-p1-monomial](ii) to twist zero to obtain H1(O(0))=0. The constructed ProjectiveSpace.unitIsoTwistZero identifies the structure module with O(0); transport H1 vanishing along its inverse. Apply the additive equivalence of [lem-sc-module-cohomology-source-comparison] at degree one and the structure module to transport this subsingleton result to RingedSpace.moduleCohomology, exactly as in the final clause of the Lean statement. Conjoin this with the preceding conclusions.
